# Pull request

## What changed

Describe the focused change and its user-visible effect.

## Why

Link the issue or explain the concrete problem.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run check:fixtures`
- [ ] Production build, when affected
- [ ] Desktop and narrow-width review, when the interface changed

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No credentials, private data, or improperly licensed material
- [ ] No new tracking, data collection, or live model call without prior agreement
- [ ] Documentation reflects current implemented behavior
